findings.containment: This retains the focus-grounded relation carried by the trusted cross-run record; it does not claim that every covering or every garden occurrence elsewhere has this configuration.

findings.title: Nimet bahçesinin yöneldiği yol
findings.claim: When the focus promise of gardens of bliss meets the supplied Fātiḥa relation, the destination can be heard as the positive end of a bounded route distinguished from anger and straying.
findings.mechanism: The focus relation joins a conditional response to divine admission into blissful gardens, while the exact 1:7 connection supplies favor as a route-boundary relation alongside anger and straying. The contact turns the destination from a free-standing reward label into an oriented end of favor.
findings.reader_payoff: The garden destination gains direction: it is perceptible as where a favored route leads, while the focus's own promise remains recoverable.
findings.containment: The packet supplies exact 1:7 surface and a relation note but no target morphology. No lexical identity, Fātiḥa-wide system, or claim about the other supplied Fātiḥa units is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The single supplied Fātiḥa connection is a medium retrieval nomination with exact target Arabic but no trust label or target morphology; the route effect is a qualified relation-level inference.

friction_notes: The connection rows provide exact target Arabic and authored relation notes but omit target morphology and trust labels; connection-only findings are therefore qualified and do not assert lexical identity.
The HFT source is legacy-unbound. Registered focus branches retain their exact gloss and facet statements; unresolved HFT branches remain attributed with null gloss and facet fields.
The 5:66 retrospective reading is retained only as a qualified image-level extension because its support sentence supplies no exact target surface or independent branch record.
The explicit Fātiḥa contact in this packet is limited to 1:7; no wider claim is made for 1:2-1:6.
Many garden, belief, and guarding connections are formulaic corroborations. They were not separately retained when they added no materially distinct carrier-trigger mechanism or reader payoff.
